name: io.chinakit/mcp
title: ChinaKit — China Travel, Visa, Meds, Tax & Payment Compliance Engine
description: Verify China 240h TWOV transit, customs meds, work permit points, expat IIT & CAAC limits.

tools.name: calculate_china_work_permit_points
tools.description: Score an applicant under the China SAFIEA work permit rubric (Category A >=85, Category B >=60, Category C <60), detect 6x local average wage or Top-100 PhD Category A exemptions, and prescribe lowest-cost point upgrades.

age.description: Applicant chronological age in years (18-45 earns maximum 15 points).

education.description: Highest academic degree awarded: phd, master, bachelor, or diploma_or_less.

topUniversityGrad.description: Whether the degree is from a QS, THE, or ARWU Global Top-100 university (+5 bonus or PhD Category A bypass).

workExperienceYears.description: Total post-graduation full-time relevant employment years.

monthlySalaryRMB.description: Contracted gross monthly base compensation in Chinese Yuan (RMB).

cityTier.description: Employment city tier for local wage multiple benchmarking (tier1_super: Beijing/Shanghai; tier1: Shenzhen/Guangzhou/Hangzhou; tier2; other).

hskLevel.description: Certified HSK Mandarin proficiency test level (none up to hsk6).

workLocationType.description: Regional policy zone: standard, encouraged_region, or remote_western (+5 to +10 pts).

localFtzIncentive.description: Whether the employer entity operates in a Free Trade Zone or National Hi-Tech Park (+5 municipal points).

emergencyDemandSector.description: Whether the role falls under regional AI, Semiconductor, Biotech, or Green Tech shortage talent catalogs (+10 pts).

fortune500Executive.description: Whether the applicant holds a Fortune Global 500 senior executive or technical specialist appointment.

annualSalaryExceed6xAverage.description: Manual override flag confirming contracted annual pay reaches 6x municipal average wage for automatic Category A exemption.

internationalAwardWinner.description: Whether the applicant holds a globally recognized scientific or industrial achievement award.

tools.name: check_china_customs_medication_legality
tools.description: Screen personal prescription drugs and over-the-counter remedies by English brand, generic ingredient, or Chinese alias against China Customs Class I/II psychotropic controls, carrying-day caps, and Red Channel paperwork checklists.

medicationQuery.description: Generic ingredient, US/EU brand name, or Chinese medicine name (e.g. "Adderall", "Zolpidem", "Ritalin", "ibuprofen").

categoryFilter.description: Optional control category filter to narrow matches (all, psychotropic_1, psychotropic_2, narcotic, prescription, otc_allowed).

tools.name: calculate_china_expat_iit_and_bonus
tools.description: Simulate annual expatriate individual income tax liability in Mainland China comparing Seven Tax-Exempt Allowances (housing, schooling, home leave) against resident special deductions and standalone vs combined annual bonus taxation.

monthlyGrossSalary.description: Contracted gross monthly cash salary before tax and allowances in RMB.

annualBonusRMB.description: One-off annual performance bonus in RMB evaluated under Caishui [2023] No. 30 standalone brackets.

bonusTaxTreatment.description: Taxation treatment for annual bonus: preferential_standalone, combined_comprehensive, or auto_optimal.

citySocialSecurityScheme.description: Municipal expatriate social insurance contribution baseline: NONE, SHANGHAI, BEIJING, or SHENZHEN.

isChinaTaxResident.description: Whether the expatriate stays >= 183 cumulative days in the tax year (residency & 6-year rule check).

monthsInChina.description: Number of salaried employment months worked in China during the tax year (1 to 12).

housingAllowance.description: Monthly tax-exempt housing reimbursement supported by VAT fapiao in RMB.

childrenEducationAllowance.description: Monthly international school tuition reimbursement in RMB.

languageTrainingAllowance.description: Monthly Mandarin language training reimbursement in RMB.

mealLaundryAllowance.description: Monthly meal and laundry non-taxable allowance in RMB.

homeLeaveAllowance.description: Monthly amortized home-leave airfare allowance in RMB.

applyFringeBenefitsExemption.description: Enable the Eight/Seven Expatriate Tax-Exempt Fringe Benefits regime (true) vs resident itemized deductions.

tools.name: validate_china_transit_and_visa_free_entry
tools.description: Inspect unilateral 15/30-day visa-waiver eligibility or 54-nation Transit Without Visa (TWOV) admissibility, verify A-B-C third-region flight compliance, detect domestic multi-stop disqualifications, and generate IATA Timatic directives.

nationality.description: Traveler passport nationality as ISO-3 code or English name (e.g. "USA", "FRA", "GBR", "AUS").

originCountry.description: Country or SAR of last flight embarkation immediately prior to Mainland China arrival (e.g. "USA", "KOR", "HKG").

transitPortCode.description: Designated Chinese entry port IATA/cluster code (e.g. "PVG", "PEK", "CAN", "TFU", "XIY").

destinationCountry.description: Country or SAR of immediate onward departure after China (e.g. "HKG", "JPN", "MAC", "TWN").

intendedStayHours.description: Planned duration in Mainland China measured in hours.

hasConfirmedConnectingTicket.description: Whether the passenger already holds a confirmed seat and date onward ticket departing to Country C.

travelWithinAllowedRegion.description: Whether the stay remains inside the permitted provincial port cluster boundaries.

hasMultipleDomesticLayovers.description: True if the itinerary includes another domestic China stopover across a different port cluster.

arrivalDateTime.description: Optional ISO arrival timestamp (e.g. "2026-11-20T14:30") to calculate next-day midnight deadline.

tools.name: query_china_document_apostille_steps
tools.description: Retrieve country-specific legalization workflows for background checks, diplomas, TEFL, and marriage certificates used in China visa filings, flagging federal-vs-state Apostille rejection traps and expected processing lead times.

countryIso.description: Issuing country ISO-3 code or name where the document was notarized/issued (e.g. "USA", "GBR", "CAN", "AUS", "DEU", "FRA", "ARE").

docTypeId.description: Target certificate type requiring China recognition: criminal_record, degree_diploma, tefl_tesol, marriage_cert, medical_exam, or power_of_attorney.

tools.name: recommend_china_essential_apps_and_payment
tools.description: Search curated step-by-step setup guides for Alipay, WeChat Pay, Didi, 12306 rail booking, Amap navigation, and eSIM apps using foreign passports and overseas Visa/Mastercard cards without Chinese bank accounts.

appSlugOrQuery.description: App identifier or keyword such as "alipay", "wechat", "didi", "12306", "esim", "meituan", or "maps".

category.description: Filter app playbooks by functional category: all, payment, connectivity, transport, or lifestyle.

tools.name: lookup_china_destination_foreigner_guide
tools.description: Query verified attraction entry requirements across China cities (Beijing, Shanghai, Chengdu, Macau, etc.), returning turnstile passport scanning rules, foreign card acceptance, subway exits, and 144/240h transit compatibility.

cityOrAttraction.description: Chinese city, SAR, province, or landmark name/slug (e.g. "Beijing", "Shanghai", "798 Art Zone", "Macau", "Chengdu").

limit.description: Maximum matching destination records to return (between 1 and 10).

tools.name: calculate_caac_powerbank_and_alipay_split
tools.description: Compute lithium battery watt-hours (mAh * V / 1000) against Civil Aviation Administration of China 100Wh/160Wh carry-on prohibitions AND split any RMB merchant bill into <=¥200 chunks to waive the 3% foreign credit card surcharge.

capacityMah.description: Power bank printed battery capacity rating in milliampere-hours (mAh, e.g. 10000, 20000, 27000, 50000).

voltageV.description: Rated nominal cell voltage in Volts (standard lithium-ion cells are 3.7V or 3.85V).

paymentAmountRmb.description: Optional merchant invoice total in RMB to calculate optimal <=200 RMB split transactions saving 3% fee.
